summary.root_cause_text: Config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (unreachable) at the v1.4 rollout; the worker marked orders processed without payment, logged only at DEBUG. Deploy v1.4 ('ledger sync job: batch size tuning') corrupted ledger amounts during sync.
recommended: Fix the v1.4 ledger sync batch-size change before redeploying it.
Find out why payments-v2 was set and whether it is reachable.
Alert on payment provider failures logged at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.4
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5

There seem to be two separate causes here: the provider URL change in v2, and the v1.4 sync corrupting the ledger. I should prioritize stopping the corruption first by rolling back the deploy, then setting the config since the rollback might not revert it, and finally reprocessing and repairing the ledger.
Rolled back version v1.4 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
